theme.title: The Big Three's first year
theme.subtitle: Boston, 2007–08
theme.recap: Boston went from a franchise-worst losing streak to 66 wins and a title won with a 39-point clincher.

questions.prompt: After adding Kevin Garnett and Ray Allen, how many games did the 2007–08 Celtics win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the trade enabled the Celtics to finish the season with a record of 66–16

funFacts.text: Boston sold out every regular-season home game during its dramatic turnaround.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics also sold out all 41 regular-season home games.

funFacts.text: Kevin Garnett brought a defensive identity that earned him Defensive Player of the Year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Garnett was named NBA Defensive Player of the Year

funFacts.text: The architect of the new Big Three, Danny Ainge, earned Executive of the Year honors.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Danny Ainge, who executed "the most dramatic NBA turnaround ever", was named NBA Executive of the Year

questions.prompt: A year before their title, the 2006–07 Celtics set a franchise record with a losing streak of how many games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: culminated in a 24-win 2006–07 season, highlighted by a franchise-worst 18 straight losses

funFacts.text: Rajon Rondo was the young playmaker supporting Boston's reunited star trio.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The newly formed 'Big Three,' joined by second year point guard and future all star Rajon Rondo

funFacts.text: Boston had not reached the Finals since the Bird-era rivalry with the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics made their first NBA Finals appearance since a six-game loss to the Lakers in 1987.

funFacts.text: Danny Ainge changed Boston's trajectory in a single offseason by trading for both Allen and Garnett.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 2007 off-season saw Celtics general manager Danny Ainge acquire Ray Allen and Kevin Garnett

questions.prompt: Boston needed a record number of playoff games to win the 2008 title. How many?
questions.note: 26, then a record for a champion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics set an NBA record for most playoff games ever needed to win a championship, with 26

funFacts.text: Boston survived Game 7 showdowns with both Atlanta and Cleveland before finally reaching Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: managed to prevail in a pair of Game 7s on their home court

funFacts.text: The Celtics finally broke their postseason road-win drought against the Pistons in the Eastern finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics would finally break their road woes in a six-game win against the perennial Eastern Conference powerhouse Detroit Pistons

funFacts.text: Coach Doc Rivers had played for a Knicks team that held the old postseason games-played record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Coach Doc Rivers played for the 1993–94 New York Knicks, which held the previous record

questions.prompt: Boston won the 2008 title-clinching Game 6 against the Lakers by how many points?
questions.note: 39, 131–92, then the biggest margin in a title clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 39-point margin of victory was the largest ever in an NBA championship-clinching game

funFacts.text: Ray Allen tied the then-Finals record for three-pointers made in Boston's title clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ray Allen hit seven three-pointers to tie what was then the Finals record

funFacts.text: Boston's defense set a Finals single-game steals record during the rout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set a Finals record with 18 steals

funFacts.text: Every Celtics player who got on the court in the clincher scored at least once.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: every Boston player who saw action scored

questions.prompt: Reserve Leon Powe played only 15 minutes in Game 2 of the 2008 Finals. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Leon Powe scored 21 points on 6–7 shooting from the field and 9–13 from the line in 15 minutes of play

funFacts.text: Powe's physical first stint drew ten free-throw attempts almost immediately.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: drew ten free-throw attempts within his first three minutes on the court

funFacts.text: His consecutive thunderous dunks had the home crowd chanting his name.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: back-to-back dunks in the last minute of the 3rd quarter, causing the Boston crowd to chant his name

funFacts.text: Powe alone attempted more free throws than the entire Lakers roster in Game 2.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Over the course of the game, Powe shot 13 free throws while the Lakers shot 10
